name: NaWF/AeWF Dangerzone Championship
epitaph: First contested in a twenty-man battle royal on 21 September 1998 that ended with no champion crowned after a masked faction attacked the final two entrants.

name: NaWF/AeWF North American Tag Team Championship
epitaph: First contested in a four-team elimination match on 2 October 1998, won by the Mongolian Assassins.
